# Import libraries

```{r}
rm(list = ls()) # Empty up the environment

library('rstan')
library('glue')
```

# R-Stan options

```{r}
options(mc.cores = parallel::detectCores())
rstan_options(auto_write = TRUE)
```

# Import to be used dataset

```{r}
amydacc_data <- read.csv('/Users/kenneth.van.der.zee/Documents/phd_1_analysis/pre-processed/modelling_data/combined_dataframe_binary.csv', sep = ';')

names(amydacc_data)[names(amydacc_data) == 'trial'] <- 'N'
```

# Prepare data for Stan

```{r}
data_formatted_for_stan <- list(
  N = nrow(amydacc_data),
  S = length(unique(amydacc_data$subject_id)),
  subject_id = as.integer(amydacc_data$subject_id - min(amydacc_data$subject_id) + 1), # This is to ensure that all subject_id's start at 1
  subjectively_correct_int = amydacc_data$subjectively_correct_int,
  stimuli_type = amydacc_data$stimuli_type,
  volatility = amydacc_data$valence,#volatility,
  response_int = amydacc_data$response_int
)

```

# Run through model

```{r}
fit <- stan(file = 'AmydACC_model_2.stan', data = data_formatted_for_stan, iter = 20000, chains = 4) # 50000 is ideal
```

# Print raw model results

```{r}
print(fit)
```

# Average the model learning rates

```{r}
# Extract samples
fit_summary <- summary(fit)
summary_df <- as.data.frame(fit_summary$summary)

alpha0_mu <- summary_df["alpha0_mu", "mean"]
alpha1_mu <- summary_df["alpha1_mu", "mean"]


# Print the averages
glue('Average learning rate for the stable blocks is {plogis(alpha0_mu)}\n')
glue('Average learning rate for the volatile blocks is {plogis(alpha0_mu+alpha1_mu)}') # check whether they should be added up or not
```

```{r}
traceplot(fit, pars = 'alpha0_mu')
traceplot(fit, pars = 'alpha1_mu')

summary(fit)$summary[, "n_eff"]
```
